title: Mosaic view file (not a normative file)
description: Shape of a view file for `mosaic view` and `mosaic export` (docs/design.md, Implementation plan, View file; answer on #120). Every key is optional: an empty view file, or none, gives M2's viewer. Whether the named types and properties are in the mosaic is checked by the page, not by this schema.

search.description: How the search box searches. Default: semantic.

theme.description: Light or dark, or auto to follow the system. Default: auto.

types.description: The node types that appear, in the order written. Default: every node type, by name. A type left out is absent from the type list and tables only; search and links still reach its nodes.
Which types an export carries. Its meaning and default are set by plan slice M3.10.

label.description: Shown instead of the type name. Default: the type name.

columns.description: Its table: the node's name, then these properties. Default: every declared property.

page.description: Its node page: these properties and edge types, in this order. Default: every property and every edge type.

names.description: Labels for this type's property and edge type names. Default: none, the mosaic's own names.
